item.title: Component Discovery - the Missing Kubernetes Primitive
item.description:
The Manual Grind

Platforms like OpenControlPlane run service providers that install and manage services (Flux, Crossplane, Kro, …) on behalf of their users. Each service provider needs to know which versions of a service are available and where to fetch the corresponding artifacts from. Today, that means hardcoding OCI references (image URLs, chart registries, pull secrets) into provider configs, per version, per service:

item.title: Shipping SBOMs with Your Components
item.description:
The Problem

OCM already tells you which artifacts a component delivers: its Software Bill of Delivery. But that does not answer the question a security team actually has: “which dependencies are bundled inside those artifacts, and am I affected by this vulnerability?” Knowing a component ships an OCI image and a CLI binary as a resource does not tell anything about the packages and libraries buried inside that resource.

item.title: Welcome Ilja Weis to the OCM Technical Steering Committee
item.description:
We are glad to announce that Ilja Weis from BWI GmbH has been voted into the OCM Technical Steering Committee.

BWI, the IT service provider for the German Armed Forces, joined the NeoNephos Foundation as a Premier Member earlier this year. Since then, the collaboration has been active: BWI contributed ocm-kit to the OCM community repository, a Go library and CLI tool for working with OCM-based Helm values templates. The TSC accepted the contribution unanimously in April 2026.

item.title: OCM v2: A Fresh Foundation for Secure Software Delivery
item.description: We are excited to announce OCM v2 — a ground-up rebuild of the Open Component Model tooling stack. A new CLI, Kubernetes controllers, and Go library — designed from the start for modularity, security, and community contribution. The entire stack continues to implement the OCM Specification v2, ensuring full compatibility with the standard that defines how components, resources, and signatures are represented.
